name: Tang Paradise
description: Furong Garden was a royal forbidden garden during the Tang Dynasty. The garden has palaces, undulating pavilions, and elegant buildings such as Ziyun Tower, Caixia Pavilion, and Linshui Pavilion. It is a tourist attraction for royal nobles. It is located in the beautiful Qujiang. It was originally Yichun Garden built by the Qin Dynasty. During the Sui and Tang Dynasties, it was renamed Furong Garden and expanded. The landscape in the garden fully reflects the style of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Every time during the Qujiang Convention, Emperor Ming of the Tang Dynasty would bring his concubines and hundreds of officials to the Furong Garden to have fun with the people. The grand scene was extraordinary.
